Background / Context

This project involves developing a simplified microblogging platform, inspired by Twitter. The application focuses on core functionalities, providing a straightforward user experience.

Objectives

The primary objective is to enable users to interact by posting tweets, following other users, and managing personal profiles. The system emphasizes simplicity while ensuring essential features are available.

Stakeholders & Users

- End Users: Individuals who will register, post tweets, and interact with other users.
- Developers: Those responsible for building and maintaining the platform.
- Administrators: Personnel who may manage user accounts and moderate content.

Functional Descriptions

1. View Timeline
   - Users can view a timeline consisting of tweets from followed accounts.

2. Post New Tweet
   - Users can create and post new tweets, including the option to attach images.

3. Follow/Unfollow User
   - Users can follow or unfollow other accounts to curate their timeline content.

4. Edit User Profile
   - Users can update their profile information including their display name and email.

Non-Functional Descriptions

- The system should ensure data integrity and consistency through relational database constraints.
- The platform should be user-friendly, focusing on ease of navigation and minimalistic design.
- Security measures, such as password encryption, should be implemented to protect user data.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0042
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY (username),
  UNIQUE KEY (email)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE tweets (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  image_url VARCHAR(255),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE follows (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  followed_user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, followed_user_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (followed_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_profiles (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE timelines (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  tweet_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, tweet_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (tweet_id) REFERENCES tweets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE images (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  tweet_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  image_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (tweet_id) REFERENCES tweets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE notifications (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  notification_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_notifications (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  notification_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, notification_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (notification_id) REFERENCES notifications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_settings (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  setting_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  setting_value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, setting_name),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_preferences (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  preference_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  preference_value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, preference_name),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_activity (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  activity_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  activity_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, activity_type, activity_date),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_interactions (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  interaction_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  interaction_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, interaction_type, interaction_date),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_search_history (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  search_query VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  search_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, search_query, search_date),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_favorites (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  favorite_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  favorite_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, favorite_type, favorite_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_recommendations (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  recommendation_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  recommendation_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, recommendation_type, recommendation_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_feedback (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  feedback_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  feedback_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, feedback_type, feedback_date),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  session_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, session_id, session_date),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb
